sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "projects_table" ("project_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "path" TEXT NOT NULL, "hidden" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("hidden" IN (0, 1)), "base_branch" TEXT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "projection_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("project_id")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "prompt_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "agent" TEXT NULL, "model_json" TEXT NULL, "variant" TEXT NULL, "fast_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("fast_mode" IN (0, 1)), "dedicated_worktree" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("dedicated_worktree" IN (0, 1)), "schedule_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "missed_run_policy" TEXT NOT NULL, "run_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "auto_compact" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("auto_compact" IN (0, 1)), "approval_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "next_due_at" INTEGER NULL, "target_session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sessions_table (session_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sessions_table" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "backend_session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects_table (project_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "parent_session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sessions_table (session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "directory" TEXT NOT NULL, "worktree_path" TEXT NULL, "branch_name" TEXT NULL, "is_dedicated" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_dedicated" IN (0, 1)), "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "base_branch" TEXT NULL, "base_commit" TEXT NULL, "last_agent" TEXT NULL, "last_agent_model" TEXT NULL, "fast_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("fast_mode" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "projection_updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "last_activity_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_seen_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_user_message_at" INTEGER NULL, "plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "catalog_title" TEXT NULL, "approval_override" TEXT NULL, "pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("pinned" IN (0, 1)), "scheduled_task_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES scheduled_tasks (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "deleted_sessions_table" ("owner_identity" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local', "backend_session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("owner_identity", "plugin_id", "backend_session_id")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "catalog_hydrations_table" ("plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "projection_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("plugin_id", "projection_version")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_options_cache_table" ("plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scope" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "project_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES projects_table (project_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "captured_project_path" TEXT NULL, "revision" INTEGER NOT NULL, "captured_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "agents_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "providers_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "commands_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("plugin_id", "scope", "owner_id"), CHECK (owner_id <> '' AND ((scope = 'plugin' AND project_id IS NULL AND captured_project_path IS NULL) OR (scope = 'project' AND project_id IS NOT NULL AND owner_id = project_id AND captured_project_path IS NOT NULL AND captured_project_path <> '')))) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "new_session_defaults_table" ("plugin_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "agent" TEXT NULL, "agent_model" TEXT NULL, "fast_mode" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("fast_mode" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("plugin_id"), CHECK (plugin_id <> '')) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accepted_prompts_table" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "prompt_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "accepted_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id", "prompt_id"), CHECK (session_id <> ''), CHECK (prompt_id <> '')) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_continuations" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions_table (session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "outcome_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "side_chat_exchanges" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions_table (session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "side_chat_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "question" TEXT NOT NULL, "answer" TEXT NOT NULL, "answer_notice" TEXT NULL, "asked_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "answered_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "scheduled_task_runs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "task_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES scheduled_tasks (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "session_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES sessions_table (session_id) ON DELETE SET NULL, "scheduled_for" INTEGER NOT NULL, "scheduled_for_offset_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fired_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "outcome" TEXT NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "late" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("late" IN (0, 1)), "user_prompted_at" INTEGER NULL, "compact_requested_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_running_turns" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions_table (session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("session_id")) WITHOUT ROWID;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_interruptions" ("session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES sessions_table (session_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "after_message_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "acknowledged" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("acknowledged" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("session_id")) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE INDEX idx_projects_updated ON projects_table (updated_at DESC, project_id DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_sessions_plugin_backend ON sessions_table (plugin_id, backend_session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_roots ON sessions_table (project_id, parent_session_id, updated_at, session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_sessions_children ON sessions_table (parent_session_id, updated_at, session_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_side_chat_exchanges_session ON side_chat_exchanges (session_id, side_chat_id, answered_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_scheduled_tasks_next_due ON scheduled_tasks (next_due_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_scheduled_task_runs_task ON scheduled_task_runs (task_id, fired_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_scheduled_task_runs_session ON scheduled_task_runs (session_id)
